AND (A.BUYER, NVL(A.PLANT,'NULL_')) IN ( SELECT COD.TEXT1,COD.TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD3 COD WHERE COD.BUYER = 'KRKORE0001' AND COD.TYPE = 'REMG' AND COD.CODE1 = #{st_plant_user_id} AND COD.FLAG = 'Y' )
AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE UPPER( '%' || #{st_buyer_item_no} || '%' )
AND A.REF_NO LIKE '%' || #{st_ref_no} || '%'
AND (A.DESCRIPTION LIKE '%' || #{st_desc_spec} || '%' OR A.SPECIFICATION LIKE '%' || #{st_desc_spec} || '%')
AND DECODE(TRIM(A.MAKER_CODE), NULL, A.MAKER_NAME, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='M104' AND FLAG='Y' AND CODE=A.MAKER_CODE)) LIKE '%'||#{st_maker_name}||'%'
AND A.BTOA_USER_NAME LIKE '%' || #{st_btoa_user_name} || '%'
AND A.KEP_FAST_FLAG = #{st_doc_type}
AND (NVL(TRIM(A.CMS_REJECT_FLAG), 'N') = 'N' OR (A.CMS_REJECT_FLAG = 'Y' AND A.ITEM_MD_USER_ID IS NOT NULL))
AND A.CMS_REJECT_FLAG = 'Y' AND (A.ITEM_MD_USER_ID IS NULL OR A.ITEM_MD_USER_ID = '')
AND A.KEP_USER_ID IS NULL
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ICOMCOD1 COD WHERE COD.TYPE ='EXCCMPY' AND COD.CODE = A.BUYER AND NVL(COD.TEXT4, 'N') != 'Y' )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG MNG WHERE MNG.YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND MNG.STATUS = 'C' AND MNG.KEP_DEPT IN ('131', '132', '149') AND MNG.BUYER = A.BUYER )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG MNG WHERE MNG.YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND MNG.STATUS = 'C' AND MNG.KEP_DEPT IN ('131', '133', '149') AND MNG.BUYER = A.BUYER )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG MNG WHERE MNG.YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND MNG.STATUS = 'C' AND MNG.KEP_DEPT IN ('131', '149') AND MNG.BUYER = A.BUYER )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG MNG WHERE MNG.YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND MNG.STATUS = 'C' AND MNG.KEP_DEPT IN ('132', '133') AND MNG.BUYER = A.BUYER )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG MNG WHERE MNG.YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND MNG.STATUS = 'C' AND MNG.KEP_DEPT = #{st_sg_dept} AND MNG.BUYER = A.BUYER )
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ICOMCOD1 COD WHERE COD.TYPE ='EXCCMPY' AND COD.CODE = A.BUYER AND COD.FLAG = 'Y' )
AND A.SG_ID IN ( SELECT CODE1 FROM ICOMCOD3 COD WHERE COD.BUYER ='KRKORE0001' AND COD.TYPE ='CMDSM' AND COD.TEXT1 = #{st_user_id} AND COD.FLAG ='Y' UNION SELECT CODE1 FROM ICOMCOD3 COD WHERE COD.BUYER ='KRKORE0001' AND COD.TYPE ='CMSM' AND COD.TEXT1 = #{st_user_id} AND COD.FLAG ='Y' UNION SELECT CODE1 FROM ICOMCOD3 A, ICOMLUSR B WHERE A.BUYER ='KRKORE0001' AND A.TYPE ='CMDSM' AND A.TEXT1 = B.USER_ID AND B.DEPARTMENT IN (SELECT DECODE(C.USER_TYPE,'ST',C.DEPARTMENT,'SOF',B.DEPARTMENT,'') FROM ICOMLUSR C WHERE C.USER_ID =#{st_user_id}) )
AND DECODE((SELECT DECODE(COUNT(*), 0, 'N', 'Y') FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'EXCCMPY' AND CODE = A.BUYER), 'Y', 'N', (SELECT DECODE(COUNT(*), 0, 'N', 'Y') FROM ICOMCOD3 WHERE TYPE = 'CMDSM' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND CODE1 = A.SG_ID)) = 'N'
ORDER BY A.BTOA_DATE, A.QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ ) X
